newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Rugby league: Farrar replaces McMahon as Illawarra coach.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Rugby league: Farrar replaces McMahon as Illawarra coach.

text.p: Illawarra on Wednesday announced that former Australia player Andrew Farrar will take over from Allan McMahon as coach of the Steelers.
McMahon last week accepted an undisclosed pay-out of the remaining two years of his $250,000 a year contract with Illawarra, who finished 14th in this year's Australian Rugby League standings.
Farrar played for Canterbury, Western Suburbs and Illawarra and was reserve grade coach for the Steelers this year.
